top_signals.title: Bryson DeChambeau among players making contingency plans amid LIV Golf uncertainty
top_signals.summary: LIV Golf CEO Scott O'Neil is scheduled to hold a news conference on Wednesday, with the league reportedly facing a Sept. 1 deadline to secure funding to continue in 2027.

top_signals.summary: Congolese officials said on Monday that the outbreak had killed over 2,300 people out of nearly 5,000 cases, making it the deadliest in the country's history.
